messages:
Maria: pushed a docs PR for the sealed-network quickstart and offline bundle checksums https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472
eng-docs-bot: Maria opened PR #472 — title: 'Sealed-network quickstart: offline bundle & KMS/HSM examples'
Julian: taking a look now. main ask: can we include an nftables example? a lot of on-prem customers are on nft instead of iptables
Ashley: I can add nftables. quick question — what env var do we expect for the KMS shim socket in the sealed installer?
Maria: current runtime examples use REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT for hosted, but the offline installer service sets KMS_SHIM_SOCKET=/var/run/redwood/kms-shim.sock
Tara: small HSM note: the PKCS#11 example in the PR uses /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so — on RHEL distros the library commonly lives in /usr/lib64. should show both or add a fallback check
Julian: +1. propose adding a snippet to detect library path, e.g.:
Julian: ```bash
if [ -f /usr/lib64/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so ]; then
  PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
elif [ -f /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so ]; then
  PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
else
  echo "pkcs11 library not found, please install softhsm2"
  exit 1
fi
```
Ashley: added that detection snippet and an nftables example (basic accept rules + masquerade). pushed an update to the PR
SRE-Lead: please also include a compact port matrix for sealed-network installs: outbound 443, outbound 853 (DNS-over-TLS) optional, etcd 2379/2380 for external clusters, 6000-6100 TCP for vendor HSM mgmt (if present). make it a small table under "networking"
Maria: added the port matrix. can someone sanity-check the etcd wording — I don't want to imply we require etcd for all private installs, only for external control-plane integrations
Tara: lgtm on the etcd phrasing. couple of tiny nits: marketplace link in the footer is 404ing, should point to https://marketplace.redwood.ai/installer and the note about systemd unit name is slightly inconsistent with the packaged service (redwood-kms-shim vs redwood-kms)
Maria: fixed the marketplace URL and standardized the unit name to redwood-kms-shim in the service example. also added a sha256 checksum snippet for offline bundles:
Maria: ```bash
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle-<version>.tar.gz
# compare output against the release tag assets page
```
eng-docs-bot: PR #472 updated by Maria (files changed: 4)
Maria: requesting reviews from @SRE-Lead and @Julian — planning to merge tomorrow morning if no blockers :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Julian: I will re-review this evening; approve pending the pkcs11 path examples and checksum note present in the final diff
Ashley: noted. I'll also add a short blurb about conntrack helper settings for nftables vs iptables just to avoid surprise connection failures
Maria: thanks all — will squash the fixes and tag the changelog entry before merge

Maria: CI passed on latest push, merging tomorrow AM unless anyone objects
